content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incomplete, or technically wrong for the current codebase. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a verification workflow before changing code.
actual_capabilities: Guides agents to read, restate, verify, evaluate, respond, and implement review feedback.
Defines handling for unclear feedback, external reviewers, and maintainer decisions.
Identifies when technical pushback is appropriate for a review suggestion.
Orders multi-item feedback by blocking issues, simple fixes, and complex fixes.
Provides response examples for correct feedback, unclear items, and GitHub review threads.
limitations: Does not inspect the repository or run tests by itself.
Cannot resolve unclear feedback without user or reviewer input.
Does not replace maintainer judgment on product or architecture decisions.
May not fit teams that require formal gratitude in review comments.

use_cases.title: Triage Review Comments
use_cases.description: Sort review feedback into clear fixes, questions, and items that need technical verification.

use_cases.title: Respond To Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Prepare concise replies that explain accepted fixes, unclear requirements, or justified pushback.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Coding Agents
use_cases.description: Keep Claude, Codex, or Claude Code from blindly implementing review suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Review Comment
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a single comment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Restate this comment, list what to verify, and recommend whether to implement it: [review comment].

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Multiple Items
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate triage for a review with several requested changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for a multi-item review. Identify unclear items, draft clarification questions, and order the clear fixes: [feedback list].

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate External Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of feedback from an outside contributor or automated reviewer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to assess external reviewer feedback. Compare it with existing behavior, compatibility needs, and prior maintainer decisions: [feedback].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Technical Pushback
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced response planning when a suggestion may be wrong or risky.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a concise technical response. Include needed evidence, risk of the suggestion, and a safe next action: [context].

output_examples.input: Reviewer says to remove old compatibility logic.
output_examples.output: First verify supported versions and current callers. If old versions remain supported, explain the compatibility reason and propose the smallest safe fix.

output_examples.input: Review says fix items 1 through 6, but items 4 and 5 are unclear.
output_examples.output: Do not start partial implementation. Ask for clarification on items 4 and 5, then implement validated items one at a time.

output_examples.input: Reviewer asks for a full metrics system on an unused endpoint.
output_examples.output: Search for real usage first. If there are no callers, ask whether to remove the endpoint instead of adding unused complexity.

best_practices: Read all review feedback before making changes.
Verify each suggestion against current code, tests, and supported platforms.
Respond with concise technical evidence when you accept or reject feedback.
anti_patterns: Implementing review comments before understanding their scope.
Adding professional-looking features without confirming real usage.
Using performative agreement instead of technical verification.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically change code?
faq.answer: No. It guides review triage and response planning. The agent still needs project context and user direction.

faq.question: Can it reject reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It encourages reasoned pushback when feedback breaks behavior, conflicts with constraints, or lacks context.

faq.question: Does it work with GitHub pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for replying to inline review comments in the correct thread.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: How should unclear feedback be handled?
faq.answer: The skill recommends stopping, asking targeted questions, and avoiding partial implementation until scope is clear.

faq.question: Does it replace tests?
faq.answer: No. It tells the agent to test fixes individually and verify no regressions.
